title: Show HN: I built a tiny search engine for personal notes
text: I wanted search that felt instant and stayed entirely on my laptop. The index is a single file and the UI is deliberately small. I wrote up the trade-offs and included the source.

comments.text: The restraint in the interface is excellent. Did you experiment with stemming, or was exact token matching enough?

replies.text: I tried stemming first, but prefixes plus a small synonym list worked better for my own notes.

comments.text: A local index that can be inspected and backed up as a normal file is a compelling feature on its own.

title: SQLite on the edge: a practical experiment
